snippet.title: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE x SILENT HILL f Collaboration DLC Introduction Video
snippet.description:
Website - https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/fatalframe/crimson-re/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=DLC&utm_id=Caption

A free DLC for FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE featuring iconic costumes from SILENT HILL f is now available.

This free DLC adds SILENT HILL f’s Shimizu Hinako’s iconic Navy Sailor School Uniform and Fox Mask.
Players can use these costumes to add the ephemeral mystery of SILENT HILL f to their playthrough of FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE.

Step into two unforgettable Japanese horror experiences and test your courage and survival in their terrifying worlds!

#FatalFrame #FATALFRAMEIIREMAKE #CrimsonButterflyRemake
